raw_segments.text: Thanks ever so much for the lovely birthday present.
Everyone says I am quite the bell in my new tam.
I got Mummy's lovely box of creams and am writing.
I am getting on swimming in the photo business now.
Mr. Coughlin took one of me and Mrs. Will send when developed.
Fair day and all the beef to the heels we're in.
We are going to lock Ol' on Monday with a few friends to make a scrap picnic.
Give my love to Mummy and to yourself a big kiss and thanks.
I hear them at the piano downstairs.
There is to be a concert in the Greville Arms on Saturday.
There is a young student comes here some evenings named Ban and his cousins or
something are big swells and he sings Boylands.
I was on the pop of writing Blaze's Boylands song about those seaside girls.
Tell him silly Millie sends my best respects.
I must now close with fondest love.
